description: Conformance vectors for the CLI read models. Every entry is either accepted or rejected by the frozen schema; frozen v1 values were captured from the real CLI at the freeze commit and normalized. The 0.4.0 documented-additive read models are validated structurally against the same schema (accept + reject per top-level def).

cases.why: Additive contracts discovery field (optional in v1).
0.3.2 additive --limit: optional limit/truncated keys do not change the existing fields.
All groups empty and next:null is a valid ledger state.

explicit_egress: model provider — chat / brief --deep / review / learn review (only when ADVISERS_API_KEY is set; ADVISERS_BASE_URL)
research --web|--url — provider web search/read tool (explicit opt-in; no silent research egress)
capture --from-imap — read-only IMAP fetch from the server you configure (TLS by default)
remind --deliver --notify — optional outbound webhook or local notifier you configure
sync push|pull — the directory you provide; snapshots are AES-256-GCM encrypted before writing
bridge — Hermes file gateway: inbox/outbox JSON files are handed to the Hermes process
MCP --stdio / DSH host tools / pet-brief — local consumers; the host or reader may forward the data
ocr / timestamp — local adapter subprocess you configure (this CLI does not call a cloud OCR/TSA)
value.secret_matter: egress fail-closed for secrecy > 0 on the wired model paths (local rule layer)
value.at_rest_encryption: opt-in database vault (advisers vault seal); general data is not encrypted at rest
